verdict: Leads dropped this week on lower spend; Google Ads remains unproductive.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 130 leads at an average cost per lead of $19.85 — all of them generated by Meta, while Google Ads spent $1,239.78 and produced zero conversions. The 50% week-over-week drop in leads tracks directly with a 35% pullback in spend, so your cost per lead rose as a side effect of lower volume, not because Meta stopped converting. Google Ads is being evaluated for pause or restructure given its confirmed zero return this period. Separately, the 130 leads sitting in your pipeline have not yet progressed to appointments, and we're looking at post-lead handling to understand where that gap is.
